verdict.rationale: Sketch is a design tool with a cloud Workspace and AI features, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented policy or setting that stops user data from being used to train AI models. The local-only MCP server is a related architectural detail, not a training opt-out control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
